documentation.totalsBasis: Per-member career totals (votesCast, yes, no, absent, interest) and the published participation figures are AGGREGATE-basis: they include 743,677 vote rows reaching back to 2006 across five terms. The archive stores 157,292 name-by-name vote rows, all from 2018 onward; 586,385 of the 743,677 rows (78.9%) exist only as aggregates, and 30 of 94 members have no stored name-by-name rows. Aggregate totals must not be described as stored records.
documentation.interestRows: interestRows (119) counts recorded votes flagged 'Absent (Interest Declared)' in the vote record. It is NOT a count of declarations in the City's Registry of Declared Interest (served separately in declared-interests.json, 1,249 councillor-matched records) and the two figures measure different things and will not match for most members.
documentation.closeEvents: closeEvents counts motions (of 6,260 vote-bearing motions) whose recorded yes/no margin was 2 or fewer: 355. Recounted 2026-10-23 over all brief detail files under this single definition; supersedes earlier inconsistent figures (407 in stats, 285 in meta).
documentation.participationBasis: Participation is computed from the aggregate-basis totals above (votesCast / (votesCast + absent)). It is a recorded-vote participation measure, not a register of meeting attendance; Toronto publishes no attendance register.
